summary.headline: Saturn’s Combustion in Capricorn and Aquarius
summary.text: Astrological effects of Saturn’s combustion in Capricorn and Aquarius, including changes in weather, crops, prices, rulers, diseases, earthquakes, eclipses, and political unrest. The text gives variant effects when the Moon, Mercury, Mars, Venus, or Jupiter accompany or aspect Saturn, citing Hermes as an authority and naming India, Babylon, Khorasan, Yemen, the Maghreb, and Hejaz.
